what: ATTN-FMA (2026-10-18): the attention's products under a fused contract -- every multiply-add of the scores q_i . k_j, the context's p_ij v_j, the backward's probability adjoints dy_i . v_j, its dot sum p_ij dp_ij and the dq, dk and dv sums one IEEE fusedMultiplyAdd (C99 fmaf), over v1's terms in v1's order from v1's start; the scaling, the softmax and the score adjoint stay v1's. bcir_tensor.h's BCIR_TENSOR_ATTENTION_FUSED through bcir_tensor_attention_contract_scan_pool and bcir_tensor_attention_backward_contract_pool (portable fmaf, AVX2+FMA and AVX-512 instances, chosen as the fused GEMM's are), the native trainer's BCIR_DT_CONTRACT_ATTN (bit 32, with any GEMM contract or none, no ABI change) and Python's attn and <contract>+attn. FP32 throughout: only the products' roundings change.

files.run.sh: the records in order (bash run.sh TMP DATA [STAGE...] from the repository root)
files.attention.c, attention-t4.txt, attention: the attention alone at the language model's shapes (batch 8, 8 query heads over 4 KV heads, 48 channels, BCIR's exponential), one layer's forward and in-place backward under v1's products and the fused ones, the two alternated round by round with their order swapped, back to back with nothing between the timed calls (each contract its own outputs, hashed after the first warm-up and the last round), the operands on one mapping advised for transparent huge pages as the trainer's state is (NDT-PAGES): medians of 31, 15 and 11 rounds. A first version hashed each call's outputs on the calling thread between the forward and the backward; the pool's threads slept through it and the backward measured 3.6 ms at four threads against the 1.1-1.4 ms a layer it costs in place and back to back, so the records are the second version's
files.step.py, step-t4.txt, step-t4-kblock.txt: the 9.84M decoder's training step (batch 8 x 128 tokens) under a contract and the same contract with the attention bit, alternated round by round, every step timed alone: bf16+exp+reduce at four and one threads, kblock+exp+reduce at four
files.attribution-t4-{bf16,attn}-{1..5}.json: the step in place at four threads, statement by statement (docs/research/measurements/2026-10-13/scan/attribution.py --src runtime/c --data DATA --threads 4 --steps 8 --contract bf16+exp+reduce | bf16+exp+reduce+attn), five rounds each, the two alternated
